title: The trader reads their own paper fills and positions in Agora
problem_register_class: RC4 — Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader

owner_scoped_paper_book_readback_route_a.non_enumerating_404: Unenrolled callers with no paper book and any caller querying another trader's user_id, trader_id, tenant_id, servant_persona_id, capital_pool_id, runtime_binding_id, runtime_id, intent_id, handoff_id, or decision_event_id receive HTTP 404 (paper_book_not_found / intent_not_found).

pantheon_paper_proxy_labelling_and_human.decision_lock_arm_update: apply_paper_proxy_fill_to_decision_lock (services/agora/shadow_mode.py) and AgoraWriteService.record_decision_lock_paper_proxy_fill (services/agora/service.py) populate lock['arms']['human_actual'] and lock['paper_fill'] as pantheon_paper_proxy on both state writeback and paper-book readback reconciliation while rejecting declared_no_trade locks and any verified/imported/real fill claim.

hosted_proof.detail: Consistent with AGORA-PAPER-INTENT-EXECUTION-20261127 (docs/deployment/evidence/AGORA-PAPER-INTENT-EXECUTION-20261127/evidence.json), hosted dev execution and readback proof requires post-merge deployment to dev plus the operator-created secret DEV_AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_SERVICE_TOKEN and AGORA_PAPER_EXECUTION_SERVICE_TENANTS (the paper execution consumer remains state=not_configured until those variables are set on hosted dev). End-to-end execution + readback + human_actual settlement is verified in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_paper_book_readback.py.

existing_writers_touched.cadence: At most once per filled/partially_filled paper intent (bounded by the 50 intents/trader/Taipei-day cap from AGORA-PAPER-INTENT-EXECUTION-20261127)
existing_writers_touched.growth_per_day: In-place update on existing decision lock row (~0.5 KB added to existing row; 0 new rows created)
existing_writers_touched.cap_and_cleanup: Governed by existing agora.decision_locks entry in docs/operations/storage-manifest.json

existing_writers_touched.cadence: In-place handoff state reconciliation only when broker paper order reports a fill prior to consumer state writeback
existing_writers_touched.growth_per_day: 0 net bytes beyond AGORA-PAPER-INTENT-EXECUTION-20261127 handoff result fields
existing_writers_touched.cap_and_cleanup: Bounded by 10-entry state_history cap and 50 intents/trader/Taipei-day cap

validation.result: passed (Route diff baseline matches current fail-hard surface)
